ESO452-SC11.population_note: Measured [M/H], not interchangeable with [Fe/H]; global MF catalogue value is indirect and lacks a measured mass interval.

NGC6093.population_note: Adopted MF-model age; not a new age measurement and no fabricated age error.

NGC6266.population_note: Helium subpopulations are not represented by this single-isochrone baseline.

NGC6273.hold_reason: Known metallicity spread; a single-population model is not approved for absolute-rate interpretation. https://arxiv.org/abs/1507.00756

NGC6355.population_note: Literature composition recorded separately; frozen dynamics/selection abundances are not silently changed.

NGC6139.population_note: 12 Gyr is the comparison isochrone, not a measured age posterior; strong differential reddening remains unmodelled.

NGC5139.hold_reason: Omega Cen requires a multi-population age/composition/weight model; sample mean age is not a valid single-population replacement.

Pal5.age_source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1308.2257; existing frozen Pal5 isochrone adoption
Pal5.population_note: Existing Pal5 outputs retain their own population and calibration paths.
